about_short_description.short_description: Kraftful provides business owners with an AI analysis of customer feedback to learn what they need and how to improve the product.

product.name: Kraftful AI Feedback Analysis Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that collects and analyzes large volumes of user feedback from multiple sources to generate actionable product insights.

product.name: Kraftful AI-Generated Surveys
product.description: A tool to create and auto-analyze custom user feedback surveys generated from past data or specific topics, supporting multiple languages.

product.name: Kraftful AI-Powered User Interviews
product.description: An AI-driven solution that conducts personalized interviews with thousands of users simultaneously, adapting questions based on prior responses.

product.name: Kraftful Trends Analytics
product.description: A feature that tracks and visualizes how user feedback evolves over time across multiple feedback sources to identify trends and feature impact.

product.name: Kraftful Project Management Integration
product.description: A service that organizes user feedback insights into projects and automatically generates user stories with acceptance criteria for export to tools like Jira and Linear.
